name: ctop1-rogers
js: (() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP, s = window.CITY.LANDMARK_SITES.rogersCentre; app.selectMode('person'); app.teleportTo(s.x, s.z, 0); app.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [s.x + 1, 330, s.z + 1], look: [s.x, 0, s.z], fov: 50 }); })()

name: ctop3-cn-tower
js: (() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP, C = window.CITY, s = { x: C.GEO.points.cnTower[0], z: C.GEO.points.cnTower[1] }; app.selectMode('person'); app.teleportTo(s.x, s.z, 0); app.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [s.x + 30, 120, s.z + 30], look: [s.x, 0, s.z], fov: 50 }); })()
